title: AIOps Platform Egress Payload
description: The only data allowed to leave the collector. tenant_id is derived by the SaaS from the API key credential and is never present in this document.

payload_id.description: UUIDv7 generated by the collector at event time.

collector_id.description: Stable identifier for this collector instance (e.g. col-blr-01).

event_time_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the metric / event occurred.

source_tz.description: IANA timezone name of the originating host (e.g. Asia/Kolkata).

sent_time_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the collector sent this payload.

source_ref.description: Pseudonymous, deterministic HMAC of the real host/IP. Allows correlation without revealing identity.

value.description: Numeric metric value. Null for event-only records (e.g. heartbeat).

window_s.description: Aggregation window in seconds over which value was computed.

context.description: Short, human-readable summary built ONLY from already-redacted data.
